summary.headline: Delineations by Planetary Terms
summary.text: Astrological delineations for Mars in the terms of Saturn, Jupiter, and Venus, describing effects on wealth, children, marriage, journeys, lawsuits, illness, scandal, and moral conduct. Fortune and malefic aspects bring exaltation or humiliation.
